dct_title_s: Terra Sancta, sive Promissionis, olim Palestina
dct_alternative_sm: Terra Sancta, sive Promissionis, olim Palestina
dct_description_sm: Map of the Holy Land, oriented to the West, and divided among the Tribes of Israel on both sides of the Jordan. Drawn from Visscher's map of 1659, with minor changes. -- From dealer's description.; Oriented with north toward the upper right.; Relief shown pictorially.; Title in decorative cartouche with a fruit garland supported by six cherubs.; 2 bar scales on map given in "Milliaria germanica communia" and "Milliaria unius horae".; Includes legend: Notarum explicatio.; Shows topography, drainage, vegetation, territorial boundaries of the tribes of Israel, travel routes, places of historical interest.; Includes decorative title cartouche with six cherubs supporting a fruit garland.; Decorated with illustrations of ships and a whale.; Border of inset map features illustrations of Moses and Aaron, altars, and Jewish religious objects.; Descriptive text below inset map: Castrorum populi Israelitiei prout secundum Dei ordinationem per desertum Aegypti versus Terram promissionis Canaan Iter instituit Delineatio...; "20"--engraved page number at top right corner.
dct_publisher_sm: By Frederick de Wit in de Calverstraet by den Dam inde Witte Paskaert (Gedruckt tot Amsterdam)
